title: Che vita maledetta
subtitle: Despina, Fiordiligi and Dorabella: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scenes 8–9, recitative before No. 11
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Per Bacco vo assagiarlo, where the libretto has Perbacco, vo' assaggiarlo; Ov' è, dov' è and com' è as two words).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 71–72, the recitative before No. 11 (23 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (the two readings were identical), then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bars 2, 12 and 15), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. Scene 9, the sisters' entrance, begins at bar 17. The last bar is printed with three quarters before “segue Recitativo istromentato” and is set as 3/4. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 94, from the median length of five recordings (Böhm, Haitink, Solti, Nézet-Séguin, Currentzis; about 1 minute).
